explication: AntiDebug Breaker is a Chrome extension for JavaScript reverse engineering and penetration-testing reconnaissance, with an MCP server that exposes browser and extension capabilities to AI clients. The main workflow is selecting/configuring page scripts, applying them to a target, and inspecting hooks or debugging behavior; the MCP workflow starts a paired bridge and serves browser tools over stdio. The README documents the script families and MCP feature set. Source excerpts clarify service, registration, and MCP startup relationships, but do not show popup-to-extension messaging, so that connection is omitted.
